backend/clues.mo: Manages clues in a Map with create, read, list, and delete functions, tracking incremental IDs.
backend/main.mo: Actor providing user profile and clue management with authorization checks for users and admins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files, components, tests, and IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing purpose and behavior of all frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining OKLCH color variables, dark mode tokens, and base styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router with /echofields routes, layout, redirects, and theme provider.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component showing attribution and styling with Aero glass effect.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with Echofields branding link navigating back to /echofields.
Parses clue content into safe text, image, video, and PPT elements and renders them with validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on the user’s Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and helpers for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and loading stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend clue operations into React Query hooks for listing, fetching, creating, and deleting clues.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global styles, Tailwind layers, color tokens, animations, and custom Aero glass UI utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Implements an authenticated admin interface for viewing, creating, and deleting clues with owner‑restricted access.
frontend/src/pages/CluePage.tsx: Displays an individual clue, handles loading and error states, and gates access to the first clue until the session has started.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page with intro animation, welcome text, Start button gated by clue availability, and navigation to the first clue.
frontend/src/utils/pasteRichMedia.ts: Detects pasted media URLs and converts them into markdown or custom video/PPT tags, with a helper to insert text at the cursor.
frontend/src/utils/safeUrl.ts: Provides URL validation utilities to check supported schemes and classify internal vs external routes.
frontend/src/utils/sessionGating.ts: Handles sessionStorage flags for tracking whether the user has pressed Start.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL parameters from query or hash, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing cleanup.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, animations, fonts, and enabling Aero-style design tokens.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing features, architecture, and the puzzle/clue system’s current state.
